summary: AirJoule Technologies Corp. filed an 8-K to report entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement for a registered direct offering of 3,658,536 shares of Class A common stock at $4.10 per share, expected to close June 1, 2026. Net proceeds of ~$14.2M will fund commercialization of AirJoule Core and Prime systems and general corporate purposes. The company agreed to a 30-day lock-up on further equity sales. Titan Partners Group LLC acted as placement agent. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
